theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R δ C : ℝ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < δ → IntegrableOn h (ball 0 (R + δ)) → (∀ g : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball 0 (R + δ) → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → ∫ x, h x * g x ≤ C) → ∫ x in ball 0 R, |h x| ≤ C
